page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on KVM hypervisors. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a frequency of 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. The system is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It includes no discrete GPU accelerators and does not feature bundled local NVMe or SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported up to a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

The instance hardware configuration reflects a low memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio characteristic of compute-focused instances. With 104 dedicated vCPUs, compute density is prioritized over per-core memory allocation. The absence of local disk drives requires reliance on external network-attached volumes for all operating system and persistent data needs. Baseline network throughput of 25 Gbps provides standard connectivity for remote block storage and distributed communication.

The high core count combined with moderate memory availability makes ecs.c6.26xlarge appropriate for compute-bound tasks that scale across many cores without requiring extreme memory capacity. Recommended workload fits include multi-threaded batch processing, software compilation, video encoding, continuous integration build servers, and parallelized backend web services.
